summary: A Miami-area exotic/luxury car rental broker (speaks Caribbean patois — "fami", "fi swap", "my g") who repeatedly sends paying clients to the phone owner for short-term vehicle rentals, primarily a Mercedes GLE and a BMW M4. Between 5/17 and 5/31 he coordinated at least three or four handoffs — clients pulling up to 400 NW 1st Ave for 3-day rentals — and kept asking to be paid out his cut via Zelle, Cash App, or Apple Pay, sometimes wanting to meet in person for cash the same night. Relationship is active and transactional, but it is a car-rental referral partnership, not any of the three ALTR business lines. On 5/31 the owner told him payment acceptance is getting restricted ("my accountant's on my ass"), and the thread ended with a call being set up.
key_facts: Brokers clients for short-term luxury car rentals — GLE and M4 mentioned by name; typical term is 3 days
One client considered adding an extra $1K to the deal (5/17)

Repeatedly requested payouts via Zelle, Cash App, and Apple Pay; also offered to drive to the owner for cash same-night
Client contact number he passed along: +1 (561) 418-1572
Mentions two mutual associates: Andre (sent the address on 5/31) and Braxton
Asked the owner to video a client driving off "for content" — his own social content, not an ALTR service
One deal stalled because the client hit his card limit (5/20)
Owner flagged on 5/31 that he can't keep accepting payments due to accounting issues — open item for follow-up
